_comment: Accepted compiled-in literals, checked by tools/assetpack/audit_linked.py. Every entry needs a REASON: an unexplained one is how a real finding gets silenced. Regenerate the list with --update-baseline, but write the reasons by hand. As of 2026-08-02 every RED-sourced literal has been migrated to the pack, so all three entries here are Crystal, and all three are blocked on the same thing.

accepted.reason: CRYSTAL-SOURCED: blocked on the crystal package (execution plan item 7). Migrating it needs AssetPack_Optional to exist first -- AssetPack_Require abort()s, so a Red-only player with no crystal.pak would SIGABRT the moment this bound. Rows 0-4 are byte-identical to kWavePatterns, which IS migrated, so the Gen 1 half of the old 'wave tables' question (item 5) is closed and only this remains.

CRYSTAL-SOURCED: same blocker as kJohtoWavePatterns (execution plan item 7). Its Kanto siblings in the same file -- kKantoWaterBase, kKantoFlowerBase, kKantoGymFlowerBase, kKantoFlowerFrames -- are all migrated, so this is the Johto half of an otherwise finished file.

CRYSTAL-SOURCED (AsciiFontGFX + 768): same blocker as above. Note the verdict is 'likely', not 'copied' -- 16 bytes unique in the ROM is suggestive, not proof. Do not harden it into a claim without a second signal.
